meta.title: Re-evaluation reason is mandatory
gaps: A dedicated step to open or interact with the Request Re-Evaluation drawer and select line items
An assertion that the request was not sent
An assertion that the selected line items did not change status
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: A dedicated step to open or interact with the Request Re-Evaluation drawer and select line items; An assertion that the request was not sent; An assertion that the selected line items did not change status

args.goal: With the Request Re-Evaluation drawer already open, select one or more line items, leave the reason empty, click Send Request, and stop when the screen proves that the request was refused because a reason is mandatory and the line items remain unchanged

steps.note: The catalog has no domain step for the Request Re-Evaluation drawer, so this performs and observes the buyer-side validation directly.
Assert that the empty-reason submission produced an error rather than succeeding.
